subject: EU hosted inference: retroactive incident summary & SLA credit path
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: platform-ops@stratusai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:15:23Z
Subject: EU hosted inference: retroactive incident summary & SLA credit path

Hi Irene / platform team,

Following up on the degradation we observed in eu-central-1 last night (we posted a realtime alert to status at 02:23 UTC), I wanted to share a short, retroactive summary and the concrete next steps we are taking. This note is to provide transparency while our postmortem is completed.

What happened (summary):
- Between 01:55–02:40 UTC we saw elevated p95/p99 and a small number of 502/503 partial failures affecting hosted text-generation routes (models: rwd-small-v2 variants).
- Root cause: a scheduling regression in the autoscaler code that allowed a subset of pods to fall behind on KV cache warm-up, causing cold-paths to amplify queuing for multi-token requests.
- Impact: ~6% of requests for affected customers experienced elevated latency (>5s p95) and ~0.6% observed transient 5xx for specific long-sequence calls.

Immediate actions we took:
- Rebalanced the pool and reverted the autoscaler tweak at 02:41 UTC, restoring normal service by ~02:55 UTC.
- Applied a hotfix to ensure cache prewarm hooks run before traffic is routed (temporary guard).
- Opened INFRA-4729 and prioritized a more robust rollout gating (see link below).

What we are sharing with you now:
1) An attached CSV with the request IDs and timestamps for calls we believe were impacted (request_ids_affected_20261201.csv). Please let us know if your logs show a different set.
2) A preliminary SLA credit statement for impacted usage; we will finalize this after cross-checking (sla_credit_statement_STRATUSAI_20261201.pdf).
3) Link to the incident page and our internal ticket below; the public status entry contains the timeline and user-facing message we published.

Ask from you: please confirm if the attached request ID list matches your side’s correlated traces, and whether you’d like us to proceed with the credit as outlined. If you prefer a short technical debrief, we can schedule a 30 minute call tomorrow.

Apologies for the disruption — we understand this can affect customer experience and revenue-sensitive flows. We’ll follow up with the full postmortem within 72 hours and a remediation timeline for the rollout gating.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

From: Irene Liao <irene@stratusai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: platform-ops@stratusai.com, support@stratusai.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:02:11Z
Subject: Re: EU hosted inference: retroactive incident summary & SLA credit path

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick summary and the attachments. A few quick clarifying questions from our side:

- Can you confirm whether the 6% figure is of total requests routed to the eu pool or of requests that hit rwd-small-v2 model variants only?
- Our billing team will need a per-hour breakdown of affected tokens to reconcile credits; is that something you can provide in the SLA PDF or a supplemental CSV?
- We saw a higher error concentration between 02:10–02:25 UTC than in the global window you listed; I'll attach a short excerpt of our traces if useful.

We'd like to get the credit process moving — if you can provide the per-hour token delta that helps. Happy to join a call at 15:00 UTC if you propose it.

— Irene
Platform Reliability Lead, StratusAI
irene@stratusai.com
[attachment: stratus_traces_excerpt_0210-0225.json (excerpt, 2 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Liao <irene@stratusai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:27:45Z
Subject: Re: EU hosted inference: retroactive incident summary & SLA credit path

Thanks Irene — quick answers and next steps:

- The 6% number is of total requests routed to the eu-hosted pool during the incident window; the proportion for rwd-small-v2 specifically is ~74% of that impacted subset. I can add a per-model breakout if helpful.
- We will provide the per-hour token delta CSV and include it inside the finalized SLA credit statement. Expect a brief addendum from us by 13:30 UTC.
- We validate your trace excerpt against our request_ids CSV; preliminary cross-check shows high overlap (~92%).

Planned next steps:
1) Deliver per-hour token delta CSV + updated SLA PDF (attaching when ready).
2) Publish the full postmortem to the incident page and send you the draft for comment (ETA within 72 hours).
3) Offer a 30-minute customer debrief if you want a walkthrough of the technical fix and longer-term mitigations — propose 15:00 UTC today or 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

We take credits seriously; once you confirm the reconciliation we can issue the credit and reflect it on the next billing cycle.

— Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[attachment: none yet]

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Liao <irene@stratusai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:04:10Z
Subject: Re: EU hosted inference: retroactive incident summary & SLA credit path

Irene — following up with the deliverables Marissa promised:

- We've posted the postmortem draft to the incident page and linked INFRA-4729 for our remediation work. Public post: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-12-01-eu-hosted-regression
- Attached is the per-hour token delta CSV and the finalized SLA credit PDF for StratusAI (see attachments). The credit reflects the impacted token delta during 01:55–02:40 UTC and the standard monthly SLA formula in your contract.
- We also scheduled a 30-minute technical debrief for 2026-12-02 15:00 UTC; invite should already be in your calendar. If that time doesn't work we can move it.

If you confirm receipt and reconciliation by end of day (your timezone), we'll queue the credit for processing and provide a confirmation email when posted to your account billing.

Thanks again for the quick coordination, and apologies once more for the disruption. We'll share the final internal RCA in the postmortem (expected within 72 hours) and the long-term rollout gating plan.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
